name: Card Drift
description: A row of cards that scrolls sideways forever, each one bobbing slightly like something on water.

props.name: items
props.description: The items to show, rendered with renderItem.

props.name: children
props.description: The cards themselves, instead of items and renderItem.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full pass of the list.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Stops the row while the pointer is over it or focus is inside it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the row. Its edges fade out with a mask.
